text: I'd like you to make a realistic video looking down at a person's hands with a plain blue sheet of paper on a wooden table. I'm asking because I find simple paper-folding motions oddly satisfying, even though I probably overthink how to describe them. The video should be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Have the person fold the sheet in half and then press the crease flat. Please keep both hands and the whole sheet in view throughout the video. It should all be one fixed shot, with no sound.
